title: checklist crash class and lead receiver check catch runner resume gaps before review
body:
Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md `crash` class names the side effect that lands before its journal write (rerun must detect it from real state: registered worktree, claim file, record status, last commit subject), and the krn-lead skill step 7 runs a receiver-argv check (subagent comparing spawned argv to each receiver parser, verdict + path) before the first review attempt of any change that spawns existing commands.
Evidence: PR #203 review 1 FAIL had 4 BLOCKING crash gaps of exactly this shape (record .krn/runs/review-series/2c61c362c41220e80ad6f96a996524ba33468f8cb12dce620311f552420412d5/records/1.json); pre-review receiver check found 4 argv/receiver defects the stubbed observer could not (.krn/runs/lead/slice-run/receiver-check.md, prereview.md).
Proof: test/rules asserts the checklist crash line names the landed-side-effect case and the skill names the receiver check.
